page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, centre-right of the scan; page number and running head at the top of the column; faint text of the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed as notes since it is show-through and cut off by the edge.

main_text.p: rea! ut juvaret in aperto sole apricari, longo situ jam senta membra! Nec tamen in effrænem proterviam dissolveremur cum Vulgo, cui Dea illa ( quod pace ejus dixerim ) nimium indulsit: Alias nobis leges præscribunt modestæ illæ & placidæ, quas amamus, quas deperimus Musæ. Sed profecto, quæ facies rerum! quantus inesset officio nostro splendor, si iidem essemus, & Musarum Antistites, & Mecœnates! Quanta se castris nostris agglomeraret turba! Ut sub opulentis ex stipendio veteranis, æmularentur indefessa tyrocinia! Jam, incredibile est, quantum Virtuti conferrent, crebræ, quas illi de more consecramus, disputationes & honorificæ censuræ: Quantum haberet Sententia nostra pondus, si audientes pariter, & ratio convinceret, & fulgor perstrin-

page.notes: The last line is catchword-like hyphenated continuation "perstrin-" with "strin-" at the line end, given as printed "strin-". Facing page show-through in the right margin ignored. Long s rendered as s throughout.
